mostWorthwhile.text: Building the weighted sensors was most worthwhile: the tilt and starting-forward pictures showed how one sensor can respond to both.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the response routes to the body felt mostly like a necessary assembly step; the sensors still had to be added afterward.

surprise.text: I was unsure how the weighted sensor could detect straight-line movement, but the starting-forward picture showed its layer shifting and bending the hairs.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary, though the nerve-route connection was the only offered combination and I followed the goal rather than knowing the detailed pathway.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the balance sensors and the final eye movement connected the parts to something I can imagine experiencing.
